title: Run task-sync Git exchange on macOS and Linux with the same bounded, confined process ownership as Windows
outcome: Run task-sync Git exchange on macOS and Linux with the same bounded, confined process ownership as Windows
acceptance: On macOS and Linux, task-sync exchange Git commands (including retained-commit pinning and explicit fetch and push) run under a confined local runner that owns every Git and credential descendant, enforces the shared deadline and cancellation, and bounds output, instead of refusing before spawn
The real-Git exchange and retained-construction tests that are today compiled only on Windows run and pass on macOS or Linux as well
disposal_reason: Greg made macOS and Linux exchange support required for the whole sync („Tak. To musi byc.”, Asistant 43498a6e #892). It is replaced by the required P0 child w-6bbabe3a062b, which has the full acceptance criteria.
